notes_for_editor: One source only. Two searches, the Georgia lists in the local NHLR and FFLOS caches, and a Wikipedia lookup (no article) found nothing else that names Stokesville. The list's author says names for towers 73 and above are the author's own creation, so 'Stokesville' may be a list name rather than a local or historical one; the story says so. The list gives elevation as 166 with no units; the record converts it to 50.6 m as feet. That conversion is unverified and was left out of the story. The list's last column for this entry reads 'zoom out', which the list does not explain, so the coordinates may be approximate. The record's location precision is 'exact' and was not changed. Nearby: Clarking (GA174, 30.51678, -82.10855) is about 13 km north. The Wikimedia Commons photo 'SR94 unused tower, Charlton County' (camera at 30.5172, -82.1081) matches Clarking, not Stokesville, so it was not attached. No photos were found for this tower.
